limitations: A local rank-25 witness is not a 99-vertex graph or extension certificate.
A local exclusion only strengthens the universal rank floor after independent verification.
No endpoint exclusion, general n3 upper-bound improvement, or novelty claim is made.

normalization.automorphism_warning: Only local fibre relabelling fixes P and selects one Q per alternating partition. Every minimum F and every labelled R is then tested; no automorphism of a completed graph is assumed.

minimum_permutation_cover.coverage_argument: The columns of every target-rank permutation span a target-dimensional subspace generated by observed projection lines. rank_derivation.singular_equality_condition: If N spans ker(P+Q), D=N^T(F+3I+P), and W spans ker(D), rank(K39)=25 iff rank(D)=e and W^T R W=W^T(B^T(P+Q)^-B-P)W, where e is the number of even alternating parts.

scope: Exact K39 rank-25 equality compatibility for all seven edge-local alternating partition types containing an even part.
